stem_book: Two bodies of equal masses, moving in the same direction with momenta such that the first is double that of the second, collide completely inelastically. If the total final kinetic energy is 9 joule, find the initial kinetic energy (in joule) of the body of greater momentum.
reason: Assumes both move in the same direction (standard reading). | stem: added 'moving in the same direction' - the print omits it and the head-on reading gives 72 J
work: momenta 2p, p → K_f = (3p)²/(2·2m) = 9p²/4m = 9 → p²/m = 4; K₁ = (2p)²/2m = 2p²/m = 8 J
